name: frontend-chat
description: JDLX Official Chat — completely separate frontend + identity from the JDLX storefront

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/200.html && rm -f dist/_redirects
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk} JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64} ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk public/downloads/official-chat.apk && cp public/downloads/official-chat.apk ../frontend-store/public/downloads/official-chat.apk && cp public/downloads/official-chat.apk ../backend/static/downloads/official-chat.apk
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk} JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64} ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk public/downloads/official-chat.apk && cp public/downloads/official-chat.apk ../frontend-store/public/downloads/official-chat.apk && cp public/downloads/official-chat.apk ../backend/static/downloads/official-chat.apk
